messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please switch the camera setup to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She begins with her back to the camera, then turns to her right, raises one hand to touch her hair and face, and finally faces forward with one arm extended outward.","camera":"The camera is at a medium distance, roughly waist-high, and remains mostly static while the character rotates in place.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless crop top with a black-and-white skull pattern, a black choker, and high-waisted green pants.","hair_color":"Her hair is a vivid red.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled up into a high bun at the back of her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with a slim build, light brown skin, and a visible face shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a Ferris wheel on the left, a carousel with string lights on the right, and a pale orange sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output uses a closer, waist-up framing from a different amusement-park angle, with the Ferris wheel on the left and a lit carousel on the right. The character remains the same red-haired woman in the same outfit and performs the same turn, hair-touch, and arm-extension sequence with similar timing. The opening frame matches the reference’s rear three-quarter placement rather than a front three-quarter view.
arguments.requested_change: Switch only the camera to an upper-body shot from a front three-quarter angle, using the reference for initial viewing direction, subject placement, and framing while preserving the person, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the intended front three-quarter angle was achieved, since the start and much of the clip show a rear three-quarter view before the character turns.
unexpected_changes: The scene viewpoint changed to a different part of the amusement park, replacing the source’s ticket booth and foreground layout with a carousel on the right.
